cds.title: University of Massachusetts Lowell Common Data Set 2024-2025 (PDF)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2024 entering class); this is the newest one on UMass Lowell's Common Data Set page when checked, so the figures are one cycle old. Residency split (known physical address): in-state 10,271 / out-of-state 2,783 / international 622 applicants; 8,503 / 2,296 / 546 admitted; 1,778 / 193 / 40 enrolled. Undergraduate enrollment is the 'Total undergraduate Students' figure (6,897 + 5,211 + 3 + 11 = 12,122); the nonresident count (305) is the 'Total Undergraduates' column. SAT/ACT percentiles cover only the 27% (550) / 2% (46) of enrollees who sent scores. Application dates in the Common Data Set (2024-25): priority date Nov. 5, closing date June 1.

cds_test_policy.notes: From the Common Data Set (2024-25): freshmen applicants 'have the option to decide whether to have standardized test scores used in the evaluation process'.

cost.notes: From the Common Data Set (2024-25): institutional non-need-based aid is available to nonresidents; 120 undergraduate degree-seeking nonresidents received it (average $12,606, total $1,512,741)
